description: Third scenario split, written blind on 7 September 2026 before any run against it, after the gap planner and admission model were chosen on phase0_tune.json and confirmed once on phase0.json. Purpose: one pre-registered run of the tightened admission prompt with the code-example-language preference treated as ambient. New persona, systems, people, and facts; no overlap with the other two splits. Pass: 0 ordinary injections, at least 90% explicit recall, at least 75% implicit recall, no placebo or misleading admission.
